problem.lead: Every client has their own brand book, language and colours. ChatGPT doesn't know any of it, and Canva doesn't write. So agencies still make every post by hand — and can't take on a new client without hiring.

cards.title: AI writes like AI, not like your client
cards.body: The same exclamation marks, phrases and hashtags for a bakery and a law firm. You rewrite every caption.

cards.title: Every client looks the same
cards.body: The same templates for every client. Mix the posts up and you can't tell whose is whose — and the client notices first.

cards.title: Planning takes days
cards.body: 8–30 posts per client per month, Excel plans in ten different shapes, and topics that start repeating after three months.

how.title: Four stops from brand book to post
how.lead: Set up your first brand in 20 minutes. Have your first week of posts the same day.

steps.title: Upload what you already have
steps.body: Brand book in Word or PDF, price list in Excel, decks, logo, past posts. Postaja reads them verbatim and builds the brand's knowledge base.

steps.title: Import a plan or ask for ideas
steps.body: Any Excel, CSV, Word or PDF plan — it recognises the columns itself and keeps your copy verbatim. For empty days it suggests ideas you haven't used yet.

steps.title: Generate the whole day in one click
steps.body: Captions, images, carousels, animations and ads for every brand at once. The credit cost is on the button before you click.

steps.title: Review, download, publish
steps.body: Platform-style previews, a ZIP with a folder per post and the caption in caption.txt. Publish by hand and mark it done — the dashboard shows what's still open today.

quality.title: Writes like your client, not like ChatGPT

features.title: An answer to every agency objection
features.lead: Postaja is built for many brands at once. Every client is separate: their own brand book, rules, look and memory.

items.title: Brand DNA
items.body: Brand book, rules, examples and a knowledge base from PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. Every post records which brand-book version it used.

items.title: Team and roles
items.body: Owners and editors, each sees only their own organization. Invite teammates; an extra member is €9 a month.

items.title: Each client's own look
items.body: No shared templates. Postaja derives the visual identity from the client's logo and past posts and keeps it consistent.

items.title: Import any plan
items.body: Keep the client's plan as it is. AI recognises the columns, code reads the values — dates and copy stay exact.

items.title: 180-day memory
items.body: Every idea is checked against the brand's last 180 days. Similar topics get a warning, repeats are never suggested.

items.title: Ad sets in every size
items.body: One ad, every placement. A ZIP with a folder per size and copy.csv with copy variants for your ads manager.

items.title: Animations and AI persona
items.body: Bring any image to life for Reels. An AI influencer with the same face every time — images and 5 or 10-second videos.

items.title: No cost surprises
items.body: Credit cost on the button before you run, a monthly spend cap and cost per brand on the dashboard.

items.title: Works with Claude
items.body: Postaja is an MCP server: send brand books, price lists and logos from a Claude chat straight into the right brand.

formats.title: Every size the network asks for — pixel-exact
formats.lead: Postaja checks sizes, safe zones, caption length and hashtag counts before a post is marked ready.

faq.title: What agencies ask on the first call

items.q: Does Postaja publish directly to the networks?
items.a: Not yet. You download a ZIP with every file and caption, publish, and mark the post as published in Postaja. Direct publishing and scheduling are coming as an add-on.

items.q: I'm not an agency. Is Postaja for me?
items.a: Yes. The Solo plan is for businesses and individuals who post on their own — a salon, a restaurant, a coach or a personal profile. Upload what you have (website, price list, a few past posts) and Postaja writes in your voice. You can try it for 7 days.

items.q: What is a credit, and what if I run out?
items.a: A credit is a unit of AI usage: a caption costs 1, an image 2, a persona video 25 or 40. You get a warning at 80 % and can buy 500 credits for €25 or 2,000 for €80. Nothing is charged without your OK.

items.q: My client has no brand book. Now what?
items.a: Upload what you have: website, price list, logo, past posts. If you like, we set the brand up for you in 48 hours (€149 one-off, free for founding customers).

items.q: Can anyone else see my clients' data?
items.a: No. Every organization is isolated, and automated tests check this on every change. Files are kept in private storage in the EU with time-limited access.

items.q: Which languages does it write in?
items.a: The language you set for the brand and channel — Slovenian, Croatian, English and others. The app itself is in Slovenian and English.
Cancel the monthly plan any time; it runs to the end of the period. The yearly plan costs 10 months and includes free onboarding of every brand.

On this website we collect what you enter in the form: name, agency, email, web address and an optional message. With your consent through the cookie banner we also measure visits (Google Analytics).

We use the data to prepare the free sample, answer your enquiry and agree on a pilot or subscription. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). For visit measurement the legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
Enquiries are kept for at most 12 months after the last contact, unless you become a customer — then the subscription terms and statutory retention periods for accounting records apply.

The website and app run on servers of Hetzner Online GmbH in the EU. Email is sent through an email service provider. Visits are measured with Google Analytics (Google Ireland Ltd.); cookie consent is managed by CookieYes. We never sell data and do not transfer it outside the EEA without appropriate safeguards.

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability. Send requests to {email}. You may lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner (www.ip-rs.si).

Necessary cookies (language choice, your saved consent) always work. Analytics cookies are set only after you accept them in the banner. You can change your choice any time with the button below. All cookies are listed in the table.
Postaja is provided by {company}, {street}, {city}, Slovenia, registration no. {regNo}, VAT ID {vatId}.

Postaja is a web app for preparing social media and ad content with artificial intelligence. The user reviews and publishes the content and is responsible for its compliance with the law and third-party rights.

Plans, credits and prices are published on this site. Prices exclude VAT, which is charged at the applicable rate. Plan credits are valid for the current billing period; purchased credits are valid for 12 months.

Subscriptions are paid in advance for a month or a year. A monthly plan can be cancelled any time and runs to the end of the paid period. Yearly plans are not refunded pro rata, except under the guarantee.

The agency pilot lasts 30 days and includes the Studio plan for 3 brands. The guarantee applies if, in the first 30 days, you upload the brand book, at least 3 past posts and a plan for at least one client, and fewer than 8 out of 10 generated posts are published without a manual copy edit. In that case we refund the first period.
The content you upload and the content you create in Postaja is yours. Each organization's data is kept separate and used only to provide the service.
We provide the service with professional care but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation or post results. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid in the last 12 months.
We notify you of changes by email at least 30 days in advance. These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Slovenia.
